Roadster Flight Lab — optional in-car music library
Checked 2026-10-18. 10 recordings: classical, pop / indie vocal, ambient.
Media licenses are independent of the project source-code license.
Retain each recording's attribution, source and license when sharing on GitHub.

J.S. Bach — “Prelude No. 1 in C major, BWV 846”, performed by Kimiko Ishizaka, The Open Well-Tempered Clavier (2015). Recording: CC0 1.0. https://kimikoishizaka.bandcamp.com/album/bach-well-tempered-clavier-book-1
Source / permission: https://kimikoishizaka.bandcamp.com/album/bach-well-tempered-clavier-book-1
Local file: assets/music/bach-prelude-bwv846.m4a
Modifications: Container/codec conversion from the archived Ogg Vorbis recording and resampling 96kHz to 48kHz; complete performance retained, no edits or loudness alteration.
Original composer: Johann Sebastian Bach
Public domain original composition by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685–1750). Kimiko Ishizaka's 2015 studio recording is separately dedicated under CC0 1.0.

During playback show track title, recording artist, license and source/credits link.
Josh Woodward requests attribution at startup or while the track plays, every session.
Gameplay uploads should retain track attribution in their video description.
Do not submit these recordings to Content ID as your original music.
Local imported recordings are not part of the distributed library. Importing does
not grant permission to redistribute copyrighted commercial recordings.

The collection contains explicitly reusable recordings, not unlicensed chart hits.
No chart position, subjective listening assessment, or zero-dispute guarantee is made.
